findings.issue: Wrong decomposition: text says 病気な is followed by 'のので, which joins the nominalizer の with ので'. The sentence contains ので, not のので; ので itself = nominalizer の + で (te-form of the copula). As written it teaches a false form (病気なのので) and a circular analysis.
findings.current: followed by のので, which joins the nominalizer の with ので ('because/since'), expressing the reason
findings.suggested: followed by ので ('because/since'), which joins the nominalizer の with で (the copula's て-form), expressing the reason

findings.issue: Same defect as expl_en: 'seguida de のので, que junta o nominalizador の com ので' — the sentence has ので, not のので; ので decompõe-se em の + で (forma て de だ). Teaches a false segmentation.
findings.current: seguida de のので, que junta o nominalizador の com ので ('porque/já que'), exprimindo o motivo
findings.suggested: seguida de ので ('porque/já que'), que junta o nominalizador の com で (forma て da cópula), exprimindo o motivo

findings.issue: １０ (ten) is transcribed digit-by-digit as いちれい ('one-zero'). 10マイル is read じゅうマイル; the kana teaches a wrong reading of the number.
findings.current: びょういんまでいちれいまいるもある。
findings.suggested: びょういんまでじゅうまいるもある。

findings.issue: Token １０ has reading いちれい (digit-by-digit machine artifact); the correct reading of 10 here is じゅう.
Romaji inherits the wrong number reading: 'ichirei' for １０ instead of 'juu'.
表 in the coin-toss sense ('heads', paired with 裏) is read おもて, not the on'yomi ひょう (which means 'table/chart'). 表か裏か = おもてかうらか.
Token 表 glossed as 'front, heads (of a coin)' must be read おもて in this context; ひょう is the wrong reading for this sense.
Romaji inherits the wrong reading of 表: 'hyou' instead of 'omote'.

findings.issue: Object particle を left as を instead of お, deviating from the corpus phonetic convention (は→わ, へ→え, を→お) applied elsewhere in the bank.
findings.current: ひつよういじょうにおかねをつかわないようにしなさい。
